params.body:
## What

`bin/findings-to-issues --ernst=nu --apply` opened the three findings of severity `nu` as issues #570, #571 and #572, through the gateway (`issue.open`, control v0.28.1, one record each). This writes the numbers back into the files, so the repository and GitHub say the same thing.

The three: the bidding window on its last day (#570), the Car-Pass renewal seven days before it expires (#571), and "This page has expired" when changing a price (#572).

## Worth knowing

Opening them took three attempts, and each failure was a missing link in the chain rather than a bug in the mirror: the kind was not in the grant (the VM still carried the previous configuration), then the adapter did not claim the kind it answered (fixed and guarded in abovebeyond-ai/control#87), then the GitHub App lacked the `Issues: read and write` permission, which an organisation accepts per installation, the same dance as the Workflows permission on 16 September.

## Next

`--ernst="deze week"` mirrors about thirty more, `--ernst=later` the rest; `bin/findings-to-issues` without arguments says what it would open.
params.title: The first three findings carry their issue
